name: Université libre de Bruxelles
summary: French-speaking university in Brussels; its Solvay business school runs two bachelor's mostly in English: business engineering and economics.

handoff.label: Solvay bachelor programmes (French and English versions)

ib.text: The IB (Geneva) is on ULB's eligibility list, so no equivalence is needed. The English versions ask every student for B2 English; French-taught ones may need a French proficiency test.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business Engineering, option Anglais
programmes.ib: About 80% in English, 15% French and 5% Dutch or German, taught as language courses. English at B2 required.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Economics, option Anglais
programmes.ib: About 80% in English, 15% French and 5% Dutch or German, taught as language courses. English at B2 required.

notes: For 2026-27, European nationals could apply until 30 September; the 2027 dates are not yet published.
Medicine and dentistry need the ARES entrance exam, and civil engineering has its own entrance exam.
